exposure: delivery location (referral hospital, home, cottage hospital, PHCU+, district hospital)
outcome: receipt of the entire postpartum intervention (three CHW visits)
time to first postpartum CHW visit (days)
cohort: The study included 33,914 pregnant women enrolled in the Safer Deliveries (Uzazi Salama) program in Zanzibar, Tanzania, between January 1, 2017, and June 19, 2019.
finding: Higher parity, unknown or unreported HIV status, receipt of phone consultations, and delivery at a referral hospital were associated with lower odds of receiving the complete postpartum CHW intervention or experiencing delays to the first visit.
